title: Diurnal variations of ARGs 16S rRNA gene data
description: We characterised the microbial communities of an urban WWTP and receiving river water using 16S rRNA sequencing and shotgun metagenomics to investigate diurnal variations of ARGs, MGEs and microbial community changes.
